description: Under the Embassy, where the hotel keeps what the lobby would rather guests didn't picture. Pipework crosses the ceiling in six directions and none of it is labelled; one run is lagged, sweating, and warm to the touch. Crates of hotel linen stand against a wall that is damp for the bottom two feet. The bulb is bare and the switch is at the wrong end of the room. Stairs go up.

flags.intro_lore: Every building this old keeps something in the basement it'd rather not explain, and the Embassy is no exception: pipework nobody traces to a source, a smell nobody names, a stairwell nobody uses without a reason. Guests upstairs prefer to imagine the hotel starts at the lobby.

name: Basement
